verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents session history retrievable through its REST API for a selected time range, session monitoring in the portal, and an AnyDesk-provided open-source Python module that exports session data to terminal or CSV. Export depends on the API or scripts rather than a documented one-click audit export, and the specific fields (connecting user, target machine, timestamps) are not spelled out. Missing for 10: documented session-log fields covering who, which machine and when, a built-in portal export for audit, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can see a log of who connected to which machine and when, exportable for audit
